reviewer: AI-assisted independent static review and offline integration controls

review.equivalenceDomain: Frozen canonical absolute daemon paths bound to expected SHA values; the class rejects unbound or noncanonical paths and is not a drop-in authenticator for an unrestricted path domain.
review.actualRead: Each authentication opens the actual path with O_NOFOLLOW, reads it to EOF and checks the same dev/inode/size/mtime fields before/after/current as the cold guard. Reusing a digest requires exact actual-byte equality with an immutable approved baseline; no metadata-only or claimed-hash shortcut is accepted.
review.stableChanges: Stable same-size edits, truncation or growth return the actual current SHA rather than the old approved digest. Changed content does not replace the approved baseline. The caller retains its original expected-SHA mismatch refusal.
review.unstableChanges: Read-time identity/metadata instability remains a refusal. Both paths retain the cold read method non-atomic interval limitations; neither proves uninterrupted executable immutability.
review.contextBinding: Policy requires explicit mode plus actual binary-authentication module SHA pin. Raw/current/policy module SHAs must agree. Exact class and exact detached path-to-expected-SHA bindings are checked. Cold default adds no new pin requirement.
review.instanceLifetime: Factory creates one authenticator only in the inner observer context. Outer journal cursor is a distinct instance and has no binary baseline. Construction does not read/prewarm daemon files; first approved baseline work remains inside the first actual snapshot.
review.otherEvidence: Process birth/parent/argv remain fresh reads and are not cached. Authentication metadata is not an observation verdict cache; raw native/API/RSS/lifecycle and source evidence remain independently replayed.
review.caps: Per-file 128 MiB and total 192 MiB bound retained baseline payload; over-cap files still receive one full actual SHA pass. Caps do not truncate input or assert an RSS limit.
review.payloadProvenance: Sum of previously retained binary sizes 59,795,424 and 78,301,616 bytes, not a new SDK read or process RSS measurement. Python/chunk/index overhead and transient buffers are additional.
review.statistics: Diagnostic counters never authorize PASS. equalBytesAuthenticated is a conservative count of fully equal read blocks, not exact memcmp work or avoided I/O. SHA/equality counters can include work in calls later refused for instability. They do not establish CPU causality or end-to-end speedup.

tests.conditions: Pure small fake daemon files under REPO/.runtime/tmp and mocked psutil.Process; archived synthetic native/API/journal evidence is parsed by real validators. No daemon SDK files or live collector/API are read.
coverage: cold/warm complete app and serve identity equality and repeated EOF reads
same-size actual byte mutation with restored mtime returns cold actual SHA and preserves expected baseline
parent/argv changes and PID birth reuse remain adverse on a warm binary baseline
one inner authenticator, separate outer cursor and no daemon constructor prewarm
default cold policy compatibility and explicit mode requirement
unknown mode, wrong type/subclass and wrong expected-path bindings refuse
raw mode or raw/current/policy source disagreement refuses
non-integer/negative/empty diagnostic work remains UNKNOWN with null RSS
valid authentication metadata cannot preserve PASS for changed API evidence

evidenceBoundary.engineering01: Permanently REFUSED; no result is relabelled or overwritten.
evidenceBoundary.engineering02: NOT_RUN at review time; a separate source/passport and full fixed attempt remain required.
evidenceBoundary.remainingAcceptance: Unchanged 362 actual observations, 724 real native helper captures, exact full population/byte/source/parent-WAIT closure, full service <=2 s, native <=0.5 s, observation <=2.5 s, start lateness <=0.5 s and global gaps <=3 s. Offline tests alone do not close these gates.
